title: From Learning Resources to Reproducible Plots
utility_use_case: A researcher receives a CSV of paired instrument readings and wants a quick, shareable check for a trend or unusual points before building a fuller analysis. The article’s emphasis on a deliberate learning path and a tidy project structure motivates an engineering workflow: keep source data, notes, and generated figures distinct; use a project-local environment; and record the exact command used to make the figure. The utility then exports a labeled plot and reports how many rows it used or omitted. This is an application inspired by the book’s general guidance on continuing to learn and organizing Python work. The book does not specify this utility, its implementation, or its plotting behavior.
